steps: Create a Mi Account and bind it to the device in Developer options
Download and run the official Mi Unlock application on Windows
Wait out the vendor-enforced waiting period if prompted
Complete the unlock procedure in the Mi Unlock application
Create and verify an official Xiaomi Community account
Pass the vendor community verification process
Bind the account to the device in Developer options
Complete the unlock procedure in the Mi Unlock application
Boot into fastboot mode and retrieve the device unlock data string
Sign in to the Motorola Bootloader Unlock portal
Submit the unlock data string to request an unlock key
Apply the received unlock key to the device
Open the phone dialer and enter the service menu code to verify unlock eligibility
Visit the Sony Open Devices unlock portal
Submit the device IMEI to request an unlock code
Apply the received unlock code to the device
Visit the Fairphone support portal to generate an unlock code for your device serial and IMEI
Enable OEM unlocking in Developer options using the generated unlock code
Boot into fastboot mode and retrieve the identifier token
Sign in to the HTCDev portal
Submit the identifier token to receive your Unlock_code.bin key file
Apply the received unlock key file to the device
Boot into fastboot mode and retrieve the unlock token
Submit token to the OnePlus support portal to request unlock token file
Apply the received unlock token file to the device
Sign in with a HeyTap account
Install the vendor in-depth test APK and submit unlock application during monthly slot window
Wait for approval notification in the application
Proceed with unlock once approval is granted
Sign in with a Lenovo account in Developer options or visit the ZUI unlock portal
Wait out the required account association period if prompted
Retrieve the unlock token and apply it to the device
Enable Developer options, then turn on OEM unlock
Power off, then start the phone in download mode with the key combination for your model
Choose the unlock option shown on screen; the phone erases itself and restarts
Check that OEM unlock is still on, then plug the phone in and read it again
Enable Developer options, then turn on OEM unlock
Leave it on; this phone does not report the setting, so the tool cannot confirm it
